zones.name: Upstream, Shah Alam side
zones.route: Tasik Setia Alam and the drains south of it -> the one mapped drain that crosses the council line (at 3.09294 N, 101.44433 E) -> council corner -> trunk drain -> main ditch

zones.name: North strip
zones.route: Second east-west ditch along Jalan Sungai Puloh (y ~ 330) and the trunk drain -> main ditch at the west edge; the main ditch itself crosses the north-west corner. At the council corner a short chain of OSM drains runs NORTH (x ~ 800, out of the model): part of the flow may leave that way [verify]

zones.name: West, north of Sungai Keramat
zones.route: Ditch along y ~ 74 running east -> pond A west side; south part -> the drain along Persiaran Sungai Keramat running east -> pond A south tip

zones.name: Pond A, centre
zones.route: Local land around pond A -> pond A. Pond A outlet: drain north along x ~ -140 to -270 -> trunk drain

zones.name: Centre-east (Sumazau estate)
zones.route: No internal drain mapped. ASSUMED: north / east to the trunk drain (via the drain along Jalan Meru to the council corner). Could instead go south to the Sungai Keramat drain and pond B [TBD]

zones.name: South-west
zones.route: No internal drain mapped. ASSUMED: north to the drain along Persiaran Sungai Keramat (on the zone's north edge, running east) -> pond A south tip [verify]

zones.name: South-centre (pond B)
zones.route: Drains along Sungai Keramat (running west) and north along x ~ 323 and x ~ 825 -> junction between the ponds -> pond B. A short link joins pond B to pond A: they may work as one system [verify]

zones.name: East, Klang side
zones.route: Retention pond OSM 721223351 (4.9 ha, not in the pond contract) and the drain running north-west from it, plus the drain along Jalan Meru -> council corner -> trunk drain

zones.name: South-east
zones.route: Drains along Persiaran Astana (OSM 1329626248-50) run east, out of the model. Outlet unknown [TBD]
